summary: Blockade Monday: US naval blockade of Iranian ports active since 10AM ET Sunday. WTI surges to $104.24 (+8%), Gold hits $4,850+. Dow futures -517pts overnight then V-reverse after Trump 'called by the other side'. Markets close green: S&P +1.02%, Nasdaq +1.23%. Goldman Sachs Q1 blowout: EPS $17.55 vs $16.32 est. IMF slashes global growth to 2.7%. Major bank earnings week begins. BTC breaks $73K resistance on safe-haven demand.

risks.label: US Naval Blockade — Iranian Ports Sealed
risks.detail: Active since 10AM ET Sunday April 13. USS Gerald Ford + USS Harry S Truman CSGs deployed. Iranian-flagged ships boarded. Iran called it 'an act of war'. No shots fired yet. Any naval incident = immediate oil >$115, S&P -5%+.

risks.label: WTI $104 — Oil Shock Active
risks.detail: WTI surged +8% Sunday on blockade announcement to $104.24. Brent $103+. $110 break triggers algorithmic equity selling. Sustained $100+ oil for 3+ weeks risks stagflation trap.

risks.label: Stagflation Trap Risk
risks.detail: Fed cannot cut (oil-driven CPI surging) and cannot hike (growth slowing). IMF cut 2026 US growth to 1.8% from 2.2%. If blockade extends 2+ weeks, recession probability climbs sharply.

risks.label: NATO Fracture — UK/France Refuse Blockade
risks.detail: UK formally refused to join blockade. France/UK convening talks on 'freedom of navigation'. NATO emergency session Tuesday. Sharpest US-UK diplomatic rift since Iraq War 2003.

risks.label: IMF Growth Slashed to 2.7%
risks.detail: IMF WEO April 14: global growth cut from 3.1% to 2.7%. US cut to 1.8%, China to 4.1%, Eurozone to 0.9%. Oil >$110 scenario = additional -0.6pp cut.

risks.label: JPMorgan Loan Loss Provisions (Tuesday)
risks.detail: If JPM takes >$3B in Iran-related provisions, sector-wide derating likely. This is the credit quality signal for the entire financial sector.

events.label: Iran Back-Channel Talks
events.detail: Trump: 'We've been called by the other side.' Oman and Qatar believed to be intermediaries. A 72-hour humanitarian pause = oil -$8-10. Monitor Oman FM and Qatar state media.

events.detail: JPM EPS est. $5.45, Rev $49.13B. WFC EPS est. $1.26. Loan loss provisions are the number within the number. Sets tone for entire financial sector.

events.detail: Consensus +4.8% YoY. Beat >5% = EM rally, copper bid. Miss <4.3% = PBOC easing signal, China slowdown fears.
